exposure: Chronic delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) exposure (daily THC edible pre-conception and throughout pregnancy)
outcome: Extracellular vesicle associated-miRNAs in cerebrospinal fluid
cohort: The study included 10 rhesus macaques, divided into a control group (n=5) and a THC-exposed group (n=5).
finding: THC exposure was associated with significant age by sex interactions in brain growth, differences in fetal brain histology indicative of dysregulation, and altered extracellular vesicle associated-miRNAs linked to dysregulated axonal guidance and netrin signaling.
gest_age: Fetal observations were made at gestational days 85, 110, 135, and 155, with delivery at G155.
